/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('validation/rc10/candidate-runtime');f=p/'learning-governance-eligibility-note.md'
assert f.is_file(),'Missing note file'
r=subprocess.run(['multica','--workspace-id','0b02adb6-a395-46bd-bd92-6fec14dee20e','issue','comment','add','01a0dda7-01b9-76f7-b53b-e2e629a042c2','--content-file',str(f),'--output','json'],capture_output=True)
(p/'learning-governance-note-receipt.json').write_bytes(r.stdout)
if r.returncode:
 (p/'learning-governance-note-receipt.stderr.txt').write_bytes(r.stderr);print('Command failed; exit',r.returncode)
else:
 x=json.loads(r.stdout);print(json.dumps({'commentId':x.get('id'),'contentMatchesIgnoringTrailingNewline':x.get('content','').rstrip('\\n')==f.read_text().rstrip('\\n')},ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
PY"
